description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect from 08.01.2024 to 14.01.2024
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the determination of exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It is a regulatory matter issued by the Director General of Customs under statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
